data.one_liner: Flutter utility functions, extension methods, and custom widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides an expansive set of extension methods for BuildContext, Color, and Brightness alongside convenience widgets like custom modal bottom sheets and enhanced buttons. It also supplies a navigation observer that logs navigation routes to the console.
use_when: You want shortcut extension getters on BuildContext for Theme.of(context), MediaQuery.of(context), etc.
You need convenient color manipulation and brightness helpers.
You want custom button variants that easily support loading indicators and enabled states.
avoid_when: You prefer avoiding heavy third-party collections of loosely related utilities and want to write standard helpers yourself.
You do not use Material Design.
strengths: Significantly reduces boilerplate code when accessing InheritedWidgets via BuildContext extensions.
Includes helpful button variants with built-in loading states.
Offers clean extensions on Color and Brightness.
weaknesses: Combines multiple unrelated utility domains into a single monolithic package.
Documentation for every feature is scattered across links rather than fully explained in the README.
